ability.name: Raise the Banners
ability.effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a **^^Serfs^^** unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a **^^Knights^^** unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
